text:
lena_ae: Quick flag  I'm planning a small schema update to the ratecard tomorrow: add `rc_version`, `deprecated_since`, and `compatible_skus`. This affects how DealDesk surfaces legacy SKUs. Need buy-in.
mark_dealdesk: Do we expect any price changes or just metadata?
lena_ae: Metadata-only. No price deltas. We want a UI banner for deprecated SKUs and an auto-suggest of compatible SKUs when quoting.
ciara_revops: Recommend `sunset_grace_days=60` default and a `deprecation_mode` field: preserve|migrate|block. Default preserve for live quotes.
noah_pricing: Also add `approval_level` (e.g., "ae|dealdesk|legal") and `poc_discount_cap` so POCs can't exceed finance caps.
mark_dealdesk: For exceptions: include `exception_ticket` (Jira link) and `exception_flag=true` so DealDesk shows the banner and link.
ops-bot: Ops note: staging window 2026-06-10T02:00-04:00Z. Backup DB before migration.
ciara_revops: Migration plan: stage deploy -> smoke test 3 quote flows (poc, multi-year, regional surcharge) -> prod after 48h if green.
lena_ae: Draft metadata sample for staging:
```json
{"sku":"redwood-gen-8k","rc_version":"v3","deprecated_since":"2026-06-01","compatible_skus":["redwood-gen-4k"],"approval_level":"dealdesk+legal","poc_discount_cap":30}
```
noah_pricing: Fine but clarify threshold: is >=20% a DealDesk+Legal trigger? I vote yes.
mark_dealdesk: Ack from DealDesk. I'll prep exception workflow and Jira template.
lena_ae: Thanks all  I'll post the final rollout schedule once staging finishes. Ping me for urgent changes.
